'''Sludir soap''' was a mushy<ref name="GG12" /> and gooey<ref name="Big Quince" /> compound<ref name="GG12" /> used by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sludir]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluudren]],<ref name="GG12" /> to keep their skin tough<ref name="Big Quince" /> and fill cracks in their natural armor that occurred due to injury or age.<ref name="GG12" /> The soap was [[Color/Legends|gray]]-colored and lumpy, and when in contact with [[Water/Legends|water]], turned sticky and pliable.<ref name="Big Quince" />
